title: inventory_categories
description: The 12 built-in categories plus any the carrier adds in the "Item Category" modal. Drives the category rail, the item form dropdown, the vendor category and the item icon.

carrierId.description: null = built-in (shared by every carrier); set = this carrier's own.

name.description: Unique per carrier, case-insensitive ("Category name is required.", "A category named … already exists.").

nameLower.description: Lower-cased name, written by the server; backs the unique index.

builtIn.description: Built-ins cannot be renamed or deleted (TO CONFIRM — the prototype allows both in memory).

createdAt.description: Set by the server on insert.

updatedAt.description: Set by the server on every write.
